title: Target Component Data Contract
description: Defines the schema for the gold 'TargetComponent' entity, aligned with RULES.md §7.1. This contract is for data consumers. Links targets to their component sequences.

tid.description: FK to target (internal ChEMBL target ID).

relationship.description: Relationship type between target and component.

stoichiometry.description: Stoichiometry of the component in the target complex.

_source_batch_id.description: Internal ID linking to the source Bronze batch for lineage.

_content_hash.description: SHA-256 hash of the record's content for versioning and deduplication.

_ingestion_ts.description: UTC timestamp of when the record was ingested.
